CSE - Link Source Script Offset to Statement.vi

Owning Palette: CSE Advanced VIs

The VI returns an index of a statement in a parsed CSE script that is most appropriate to the specified offset (character position) in the source script.

Click the parameters for more information

 

CSE RefNum is a reference number for a CSE instance that contains a parsed CSE script. CSE - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
Offset (0) specifies an offset in a source script (string). If Offset is less than zero, or is greater then or equal to the length of a source script string, the VI returns -1 in Stm Index.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup CSE RefNum is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CSE RefNum.
dup Offset is a flow-through parameter with the same value as Offset.
Stm Index returns an index of the statement in the parsed script that is most appropriate to the given offset in the source script. If the specified offset is not appropriate to any statement, Stm Index returns -1.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
